pages.title: Genyornis
pages.text: $(o)Genyornis$() ($(o)Genyornis newtoni$()) was the last of the mihirungs, a family of giant flightless birds more closely related to ducks and geese than to emus.$(br2)Standing a little over 2 metres tall, it had a massive, deep beak and hoof-like toes, and browsed the woodlands and plains of Australia.$(br2)It died out around 47,000 years ago, not long after people reached the continent.
